lines: I weigh what comes up. Nothing comes up. So I keep the books,
and the books are the only reason this office is still an office.
Somebody has to know what the mountain is worth when they come asking.
They came asking in the spring.
I worked the west face beside her for eleven years and I will tell you
the thing nobody tells challengers: she wants you to win.
She just will not make it easy, because easy is not worth having.
Second gauge moves. I have said so for two years.
Not much. Not steadily. But a face that is settling settles once and stops.
This one keeps thinking about it.
